features.name: Psionic Power
features.desc: You gain Psionic Energy Dice (expended on protection, extra damage, and Telekinetic Movement). Regained on a rest.

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
features.desc: Telekinetic Thrust (push or pull a creature) and an empowered Telekinetic Movement.

features.name: Protective Field
features.desc: As a Reaction, you expend a Psionic Energy Die to reduce the damage taken by you or an ally near you.

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.desc: You can maintain the Telekinesis spell indefinitely; as a Bonus Action, you use it to make an attack or a shove.
